title: What’s the difference between AI Native and AI Assisted?
description: AI tools like Copilot are game-changers in software development! While they have flaws, they supercharge coding and many developers love them. These tools fall under AI-assisted development, making existing methods more efficient. However, AI-native development is about rethinking development with AI at the core. Embrace the future! #AINativeDevelopment #Copilot #AIAssisted
